name: Tesla
story: Down ~19% on the week after signaling heavier AI/robotaxi spend — a robotaxi update on the 22nd could flip sentiment fast either way.

name: IBM
story: Cratered 25% in one session on a profit warning tied to soft software/infrastructure demand.

name: SK Hynix ADR
story: Record $26.5B Nasdaq debut; swung from an 8% rally to an 11%+ drop within days on AI-memory demand jitters.

name: Micron
story: Chipmaker caught in the broader semiconductor sell-off/rebound whiplash.

name: Lam Research
story: Moving with the semiconductor-equipment group as AI capex sentiment swings session to session.

name: Booz Allen Hamilton
story: Popped 12% after beating earnings estimates and reaffirming guidance — a defense-spending beneficiary.

name: Ginkgo Bioworks
story: One of the highest-beta small-caps on the board — big swings on light news flow.

name: AMC Entertainment
story: Perennial high-beta retail-trader favorite; still one of the most volatile mid-caps by beta.

name: Nvidia
story: The AI bellwether — calmer than smaller chip names lately, but every AI-spending headline still moves it.

name: Apple
story: Mega-cap bellwether — product-cycle news and China-demand headlines can move the whole market, not just the stock.

name: Microsoft
story: AI/cloud bellwether — Azure growth and Copilot adoption headlines are the main swing factor.

name: Alphabet
story: Search-vs-AI competitive dynamics and antitrust headlines both move it.

name: Amazon
story: AWS growth trends and retail-margin headlines pull it in different directions.

name: Meta Platforms
story: Ad-spend trends and AI-capex guidance make this one of the more volatile mega-caps.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
story: Rides the same AI/data-center-GPU wave as Nvidia, often with sharper swings.

name: Intel
story: Turnaround story — foundry progress and government-subsidy headlines move it hard.

name: Broadcom
story: Custom AI-chip and networking exposure make it a high-beta AI-capex proxy.

name: Arm Holdings
story: High-multiple chip-licensing name — swings hard on any shift in AI sentiment.

name: Super Micro Computer
story: One of the most volatile AI-server names on the board, prone to extreme single-day moves.

name: Taiwan Semiconductor ADR
story: Chip-industry bellwether — geopolitics and AI-demand headlines both move it.

name: Palantir
story: High-beta AI/government-software name, prone to sharp rallies and pullbacks on sentiment.

name: Coinbase
story: Effectively a crypto-market proxy — swings with bitcoin and regulatory headlines.

name: MicroStrategy
story: Leveraged bitcoin-proxy stock — some of the most extreme volatility on the board.

name: Rivian
story: EV-startup volatility — production numbers and cash-runway headlines move it hard.

name: Lucid Group
story: Similar EV-startup risk profile to Rivian, often even more volatile.

name: GameStop
story: The original meme-stock — still prone to retail-driven volatility spikes disconnected from fundamentals.

name: Moderna
story: Biotech binary-event risk — pipeline and vaccine-demand news causes sharp moves.

name: Pfizer
story: Large-cap pharma with real event-driven volatility around trial and earnings news.

name: United Airlines
story: Travel-demand and fuel-cost headlines swing airline names hard.

name: Occidental Petroleum
story: Oil-price-sensitive name with real swings on crude-price moves.

name: Applied Digital
story: Owns the physical AI data-center real estate rather than selling compute directly — its Polaris Forge campus is leased to CoreWeave. Capital-intensive build-out makes it swing hard on financing and leasing news.
